question: Slash and burn agriculture is also known as _______ in Madhya Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bewar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Slash and burn agriculture is known as Bewar or Dahiya in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Slash and burn farming is a type of shifting agriculture in which the natural flora is cut down and burned to clear the ground for cultivation, and then the farmer moves to a new fresh plot and repeats the process when the plot becomes infertile.</li&g
